articles.title: Asia Stocks Cling to Gains on Nvidia, Anthropic IPO Looms
articles.description: MSCI AsiaPacific exJapan index wobbly after fourday losing streak Nvidia shares reverse gains after earnings Questions mount over next CEO as Nvidia vows swift search Anthropic set to price IPO on Wednesday SINGAPORE, Nov 18 Reuters Stocks eked out a small advance in Asia on Wednesday after Nvidia posted a betterthanexpected sales forecast amid uncertainty about company39;s future leadership, while oil prices dropped after data showed rising US inventories. In choppy trade, MSCI39;s broadest index of AsiaPacific shares outside Japan was up 0.1, narrowly on track to break a fourday losing streak. Japan39;s Nikkei 225 gained 0.3 after several reversals, while US SP 500 emini futures held gains throughout the trading day, up 0.2. Nvidia39;s results were reassuring and gave investors a reason to refocus on earnings, but they haven39;t resolved the broader questions around AI spending returns, financing sustainability and leadership uncertainty, said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo Bank in Singapore. So we are seeing an initial relief rally, but not necessarily the conviction needed for a sustained recovery. In o il markets, Brent crude futures were 1.1 lower at 92.16 a barrel in Asian trade following data showing an increase in US crude and fuel inventories last week, although the ongoing Middle East conflict and disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz limited losses.
